name: print-social-anime-sky-mothers-day-portfolio-cover-with-envelope
title: Painted anime sky and meadow cover with a cream envelope card, wax seal and paper stickers
whatItIs: A painterly sky with a child flying above a meadow at left and a woman at right, torn paper edges, white paper cloud, star and crown stickers, and a cream envelope holding a card with '2026 Social Media Design', a flourished serif 'Portfolio' and 'Happy Mothers Day', sealed with a blue wax stamp.
whatItMeans: Tender and whimsical; the envelope frames the title like a letter.
techniques: Use a painted illustration as backdrop.
Place the title on an envelope card with wax seal.
Mix serif and script in the title.

vocabulary.definition: A card peeking from an envelope.
A stamped wax circle sealing a letter.
